lines.t: (Whispered)
Laundry on the bedroom floor
Bills stacked by the kitchen door
Coffee getting cold again
Same old week, same old spin
Neighbors yelling down the hall
Sirens screaming through it all
Nothing here looks heavenly
But You keep showing up for me
Not in flashes of gold light
Not in some dramatic sign...
You’re holy in the ordinary
Sacred in the small
In the middle of my Monday
You’re the miracle in it all
Not a distant revelation
Not a voice from outer space
You’re the God who stays
I’ve been waiting for the grand
For the fire, for the plan
For a moment I could say
“That’s the day He moved my way”
But You’re steady as the sun
Rising when the night is done
Every breath and every beat
Is evidence You’re here with me
[Rap Verse]
Yeah, I was looking for the lightning, looking for the quake
Looking for a mountain-moving moment just to wake
My spirit from the slumber of the 9-to-5 grind
Searching for a signal that was never hard to find
It’s in the static of the radio, the rhythm of the rain
The quiet kind of comfort when I’m sifting through the pain
It’s not a staged production or a neon-light display
It’s the peace inside the chaos in the middle of the day
You don’t leave when it gets heavy, You don’t exit when it’s dull
You’re the anchor in the ocean, You’re the logic in the lull
From the kitchen to the pavement, every mile, every street
You’re the only conversation that makes my life complete.
[Bridge]
If You walked on water once
You can walk into my mess
If You conquered death itself
You can handle all of this
[Final Chorus]
You’re holy in the ordinary
Sacred in the small
Every little broken moment
You redeem it all
No I don’t need the lightning
Just Your faithful grace
You’re the God who stays
The God who stays...
Right here.
